purpose: Synthetic local policy lookup for MCP protocol training
identity_boundary: Local child process runs as the learner operating-system identity
audit: Record server version, tool name, outcome, and duration; do not log arguments or result content
monitoring: Alert on repeated startup failure, timeout, or rejected calls in an approved deployment
disablement: Set enabled=false or remove the scoped server entry, refresh the client, and verify lookup_policy is absent
rollback: Disable the integration; no data or external side effect requires compensation
removal: Remove configuration and server access, revoke any future credential, verify absence, and retain the review record
residual_risks: Future server edits could add data sources or side effects and require a new review
